title: Sample performance period allowance
summary: Counts calendar days between two ISO-8601 dates and multiplies inclusive performance days by a made-up daily allowance. Every rule and number here is invented to exercise date inputs in the calculator template.
scope_limits: Every rule, date range and rate here is fictional. Do not use the result for a real travel voucher, period of performance or contract claim.
Counts calendar days on the proleptic Gregorian calendar and does not adjust for federal holidays or partial travel days.

citations.label: Sample Rule 45.2(a) (fictional)
citations.note: Defines inclusive performance days as elapsed calendar days plus 1

citations.label: Sample Rule 45.2(b) (fictional)
citations.note: Multiplies inclusive performance days by the daily allowance rate

inputs.label: Period start date
inputs.help: First calendar day of the performance period.

inputs.label: Period end date
inputs.help: Last calendar day of the performance period.
